name: phase1_placement
description: Does bit placement matter at a fixed Hamming weight? (critique C5.) Phase 1
§11 claims a placement term of order 0.1 W exists, from a heuristic (spread
<= 2*between) that fired at 2 of 8 weights. Reanalysing the two sweep
sessions with a PAIRED test -- patterns at a weight were interleaved across
the same three repeats, so differencing them per repeat cancels the thermal
state -- the two that fired, HW 2 and HW 8, have the largest paired t (5.3 and
-3.9), consistent in sign across all three repeats. So they are not obviously
noise. But an exact paired sign-flip test on three repeats FLOORS at p = 0.25
(1/2^3, two-sided): nothing can reach significance, and Sidak-corrected over
eight weights the smallest p is 0.90. The claim is not resolved at three
repeats, for want of power, not for want of an effect.
This settles HW 8 -- the largest, cleanest hit (hw08_a vs hw08_b differed by
0.162 W, consistent across repeats) -- at SIX repeats, where the sign-flip
floor is 2/2^6 = 0.031 and a permutation test across several patterns is
finer still. Four HW-8 patterns spanning the placement axis, each contrasted
against the all-zero baseline exactly as §6's sweep did:
hw08_a 0x0180D203  and  hw08_b 0xD004B080 -- the original pair, so the
0.162 W difference either replicates at 6 repeats or it does not;
hw08_lo 0x000000FF -- eight contiguous bits in the low byte;
hw08_sp 0x11111111 -- one bit per nibble, maximally spread.
If placement matters, the four pattern means differ beyond the between-repeat
noise, testable by permuting pattern labels across the 24 runs; if it does
not, six repeats bound it tightly and §11 downgrades to 'not resolved' with
power behind it rather than a heuristic. A real placement term at fixed
weight would be a genuinely novel result, which is why it is worth measuring
rather than dropping.
ws_l3_x8, the best-conditioned victim, and identical driver settings to
phase1_hamming_weight so the anchor and the hw08 patterns pool with it. aa_l3
is the session gate; anchor_hw16 is the cross-session check (prior sessions
+1.133/+1.215/+1.228/+1.160 W). Config-A, six repeats, shuffled order.

runs.label: hw08_b
runs.comment: HW 8, 0xD004B080 (original scattered); differed from a by 0.162 W at 3 repeats.
